name: of1-discovery-starter-paths
description: A pick-your-path starter layout offering three situational routes, each with a short blurb and a few suggested products, plus a closing availability check.

slots.instruction: Short kicker inviting the visitor to pick a starting path.
Headline asking the visitor to choose the situation that fits them.
One or two sentences explaining that each path bundles the right services with shared guarantees.
Short situational tag for the first path, such as a life moment or use case.
Headline naming the first path.
Short blurb describing who the first path fits and what it delivers.
A few suggested products for the first path, each with a name and price.
Call to action to start the first path.
Short situational tag for the second path.
Headline naming the second path.
Short blurb describing who the second path fits and what it delivers.
A few suggested products for the second path, each with a name and price.
Call to action to start the second path.
Short situational tag for the third path.
Headline naming the third path.
Short blurb describing who the third path fits and what it delivers.
A few suggested products for the third path, each with a name and price.
Call to action to start the third path.
Heading introducing the shared reassurances that apply to every path.
List of shared guarantees and reassurances that apply no matter which path is chosen.
Closing call-to-action heading for visitors unsure which path to pick.
Closing call-to-action supporting copy.
Final call to action to check availability or get matched.

label: Discovery - Starter Paths
